title: A RHYTHM FIRES, IS ENQUEUED, IS DISPATCHED — AND THE DISPATCH CANNOT BE JOINED TO ANY EXECUTION. CORRECTED AND SHARPENED
description: A RHYTHM FIRES, IS ENQUEUED, IS DISPATCHED — AND THE DISPATCH CANNOT BE JOINED TO ANY EXECUTION. CORRECTED AND SHARPENED 2026-09-05. My first statement of this gap said the chain broke somewhere unknown after the fire. It does not: the chain runs FURTHER than I claimed and the break is at a specific, identified point. WHAT DEMONSTRABLY WORKS: two timeShapedRhythm families were seeded (horizon-detect, learning-signal-health) with their rhythmFamilyGoal mappings. rhythm_conductor_tick consumed them — both come back from the pool rewritten with source='rhythm-conductor-tick', alpha raised 1 to 2 and staleness decayed 1.0 to 0.0917, exactly two applications of the on-fire decay (alpha+0.5, staleness*0.3). The boredom queue at /root/.minibob/boredom-queue.json (the DEFAULT_QUEUE_PATH, not the pool directory I first looked in) holds 30 tasks, ALL with status 'dispatched', and FOUR of them are mine — each family twice, with reasons 'rhythm horizon-detect due (score 3.33)' and '(score 1.22)', the two scores matching the decay. So fire, enqueue, drain and dispatch all function. THE BREAK, LOCATED IN CODE: drainBoredomQueue posts each pending task to GOAL_HOST_ENDPOINT/run-goal and then does if (res) { (t as { status?: string }).status = 'dispatched'; dispatched += 1; }. The response from /run-goal carries a dispatchId — that is how every operator dispatch is polled — but it is DISCARDED. The task is marked dispatched and nothing records WHAT was dispatched. A stored task therefore has no dispatchId, no executionId, and no link of any kind to the goal-host run it triggered. CONSEQUENCE: the cadence is unauditable end to end. The execution table holds ZERO rows whose output shapes include reachableButUnlearnedReport or learningSignalHealth, and there is no way to tell from the queue whether those dispatches failed, ran and produced different shapes, or ran untraced — because the join key was never written. The rhythm meanwhile debits its own staleness and credits its alpha, so it records the work as done and will drift below the due threshold and stop selecting itself. FALSIFIER: closed only when a dispatched queue task carries the identifier returned by /run-goal, AND that identifier resolves to a goal-host execution. Cite the task id, the recorded dispatch identifier, and the execution it resolves to. A closure that shows only status='dispatched' is fabricated, because that is the current state.
